glossEn: equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)
note: equipment for taking photographs。线索：digital/video + camera。The camera lens was cracked.

glossZh: 密谈（只用拉丁习语 in camera）
note: [glossEn 空：ECDICT 与 WordNet 均无对应义位] [ZH-FALLBACK 英文零覆盖] in camera：拉丁习语，指「私下、法庭不公开地」，且只用于元音前字母后（in camera / in cameras）。ECDICT 侧零覆盖，走补洞。真实但罕见用法。
